map.输入均值、标准差以及区间上下界，计算正态分布下该区间的概率（即曲线下面积），下界: Enter the mean, standard deviation, and the interval bounds to compute the probability of that interval under the normal distribution (the area under the curve). The lower bound can be a very large negative number approximating negative infinity, which gives cumulative probabilities or quantile intervals.
map.P(a ≤ X ≤ b) = [Φ((b−μ)/σ) − Φ((a−μ)/σ)]: P(a ≤ X ≤ b) = [Φ((b−μ)/σ) − Φ((a−μ)/σ)] × 100%, where Φ is the standard normal cumulative distribution function
map.把区间上下界 b、a 分别标准化为 (b−μ)/σ 与 (a−μ)/σ，再取标准: Standardize the upper and lower bounds b and a as (b−μ)/σ and (a−μ)/σ, then take the difference of the standard normal cumulative probabilities — the area under the normal curve over [a, b] (times 100 for a percentage). Entering a very large negative lower bound (such as −1e9) approximates negative infinity and gives P(X ≤ b). The probability outside the interval is 1 minus that value.
map.产品质量\"落在规格内\"比例。: The share of product quality that falls within specification.
map.μ=0,σ=1 为标准正态。: μ=0, σ=1 is the standard normal.
map.正态下分别含 68.3%/95.4%/99.7%（经验法则），快速估\"正常波动: Under normality these cover 68.3%/95.4%/99.7% respectively (the rule of thumb), giving a quick estimate of the "normal fluctuation range".
map.非正态能套用？: Can It Be Applied to Non-Normal Data?
map.不能，区间比例会偏离经验值；需按实际分布或用 Chebyshev 不等式（至少: No, the interval share would deviate from the empirical value; use the actual distribution or Chebyshev's inequality (at least 1−1/k²).
